run_make_submission_file: run the make_submission_file script to create an evalAI submission NPZ file for OC20 or OC22 datasets
run_is2re_relaxations: run the make_submission_file script with --is2re-relaxations to write IS2RE results from trajectory files
run_hybrid_is2re: run the make_submission_file script with --is2re-relaxations and --hybrid to write IS2RE results from S2EF prediction files
review_write_is2re_relaxations: review the write_is2re_relaxations function that extracts IDs and energies from ASE trajectory files or hybrid NPZ predictions
review_write_predictions: review the write_predictions function that merges split results into a single compressed NPZ submission file
